impl_iters.changes_summary: 5개 모듈 build.gradle 에 maven-publish + signing plugin 적용. MavenPublication 'mavenJava' (BOM: bomPlatform→ mavenJava 통합) — artifactId=jakarta-to-javax-servlet-adapter-{name}, from components.java (또는 javaPlatform for bom), pom: name/description/url/licenses (Apache-2.0)/developers/scm. OSSRH repository (s01.oss.sonatype.org, snapshots vs releases by version suffix, credentials via gradle/env properties). Signing block — useInMemoryPgpKeys (env SIGNING_KEY/SIGNING_PASSWORD) or useGpgCmd, required=gated to remote publish only (publishToMavenLocal skips). java { withSourcesJar(); withJavadocJar() } for Maven Central compliance (common/servlet5/6/61). Javadoc 변경 — UTF-8 encoding (Windows 한국어 로케일 CP949 회피) + @req custom tag 등록 + Xdoclint:none (release jar 빌드용).

green_evidence_meta.artifact_summary: bom: pom + module. common: jar + sources + javadoc + test-fixtures + pom + module. servlet5/6/61: jar + sources + javadoc + pom + module. Total 5 module dirs. GPG signature skipped intentionally for local publish (gated to remote publish only).
